question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocabanga ukuthi iphendula umbuzo. Uma usuqedile, cindezela u-{checkAnswer}. Uzothola impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi impendulo yakho ilungile yini nokuthi uqhubeke kanjani.
relatedContentDescription: Lokhu kudala indawo egoqiwe yokuqukethwe okuhlobene nalo mbuzo futhi kuhlala kuboniswa
hintDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi ephendula kabi
evidenceDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi ephendula kahle
hotspotDirections: Khetha indawo ngayinye esithombeni ephendula umbuzo. Zingu-{total} okufanele zitholwe.
keyboardDirections: Ikhibhodi: iya esithombeni, hambisa isiphambano ngokhiye bemicibisholo (bamba u-Shift ukuze uthathe izinyathelo ezinkulu), bese ucindezela u-Enter noma u-Space ukuze ukhethe leyo ndawo.
missLimitDirections: Ungaphutha izikhathi ezingu-{max} ngaphambi kokuthi umzamo uphele.
noMissLimitDirections: Amaphutha awanamkhawulo. Cindezela u-{finish} uma usuqedile ukubheka.
stageKeys: Sebenzisa okhiye bemicibisholo ukuze uhambise isiphambano, u-Shift ukuze uthathe izinyathelo ezinkulu, kanye no-Enter noma u-Space ukuze ukhethe leyo ndawo.
missNothing: Akukho okufanele kutholwe ku-{x}% ngokunqamula, {y}% ngokwehla.
noHotspots: Engeza okungenani indawo ebalulekile eyodwa okufanele itholwe kuzilungiselelo.
editHint: Imigqa ibonisa lapho impendulo ngayinye ikhona esithombeni. Shintsha izinombolo kuzilungiselelo ukuze uhambise noma ushintshe usayizi wayo.
